senses.definition: A process of choosing a leader, members of parliament, councillors, or other representatives by popular vote.
examples: The parliamentary election(s) will be held in March.
How did you vote in (UK also: at) the last election?

quotes.text: That brief moment after the election four years ago, when many Americans thought Mr. Obama’s election would presage a new, less fractious political era, now seems very much a thing of the past.
quotes.reference: 2012 November 7, Matt Bai, “Winning a Second Term, Obama Will Confront Familiar Headwinds”, in New York Times:

senses.definition: The choice of a leader or representative by popular vote.
examples: The election of John Smith was due to his broad appeal.

quotes.text: Whosoever searcheth all the circumstances and embraceth all the consequences thereof hindereth his election.
